descriptions.zh:
这是崭新秩序的黎明。腐朽的星海共同体已经被解散，取而代之的是§H[Root.GetGalEmpireName]§!的崛起。在宣布我们对这一新的泛星系政权有无可置疑的地位之后，我们现在又被称为§H[Root.GetName]§!。

在一个面向全星系广播的极具奢华的加冕仪式上，在[Root.Capital.GetName]，[ruler.GetRegnalName]被加冕为[Root.GetRulerTitle]，于是一个新的帝国王朝开始了。

[Root.GetRulerTitle]万岁！帝国万岁！
descriptions.en:
It is the dawn of a New Order. The old Galactic Community has been dismantled, and in its place the §H[Root.GetGalEmpireName]§! has risen. After claiming our rightful place on the throne of this new pan galactic state, we are now known as the §H[Root.GetName]§!.

In a lavish coronation ceremony broadcast across the entire galaxy, a new imperial dynasty was established when [ruler.GetRegnalName] was crowned [Root.GetRulerTitle] on [Root.Capital.GetName].

Long live the [Root.GetRulerTitle]! Long live the Imperium!

descriptions.zh:
这是崭新秩序的黎明。腐朽的星海共同体已经被解散，取而代之的是§H[Root.GetGalEmpireName]§!的崛起。在宣布我们对这一新的泛星系政权有无可置疑的地位之后，我们现在又被称为§H[Root.GetName]§!。

这一社会建构将服务于我们的机械智能，从今往后亦被称为§H[Root.GetRulerTitle]§!。这将会是一个控制整个星系诸多政治子实体的更高层级。我们的帝国臣民们将会适时地学会服从于我们的指令和我们的任一个无人机。

[Root.GetRulerTitle]万岁！帝国万岁！
descriptions.en:
It is the dawn of a New Order. The old Galactic Community has been dismantled, and in its place the §H[Root.GetGalEmpireName]§! has risen. After claiming our rightful place on the throne of this new pan galactic state, we are now known as the §H[Root.GetName]§!.

This social construct will afford our Machine Intelligence, henceforth referred to as the §H[Root.GetRulerTitle]§!, a much greater level of control over the galaxy's many sub-polities. Our imperial subjects will, in time, learn to obey our commands as well as any drone.

Long live the [Root.GetRulerTitle]! Long live the Imperium!

descriptions.zh:
这是崭新秩序的黎明。腐朽的星海共同体已经被解散，取而代之的是§H[Root.GetGalEmpireName]§!的崛起。在宣布我们对这一新的泛星系政权有无可置疑的地位之后，我们现在又被称为§H[Root.GetName]§!。

我们的蜂巢思维从今往后将被称为§H[Root.GetRulerTitle]§!，这种社会结构使我们能够更大程度地控制星系中的诸多子政体。我们的帝国臣民迟早要学会服从我们以及任一子个体的命令。

[Root.GetRulerTitle]万岁！帝国万岁！
descriptions.en:
It is the dawn of a New Order. The old Galactic Community has been dismantled, and in its place the §H[Root.GetGalEmpireName]§! has risen. After claiming our rightful place on the throne of this new pan galactic state, we are now known as the §H[Root.GetName]§!.

This social construct will afford our Hive Mind, henceforth referred to as the §H[Root.GetRulerTitle]§!, a much greater level of control over the galaxy's many sub-polities. Our imperial subjects will, in time, learn to obey our commands as well as any drone.

Long live the [Root.GetRulerTitle]! Long live the Imperium!

descriptions.zh:
这是崭新秩序的黎明。腐朽的星海共同体已经被解散，取而代之的是§H[Root.GetGalEmpireName]§!的崛起。在宣布我们对这一新的泛星系政权有无可置疑的地位之后，我们现在又被称为§H[Root.GetName]§!。

以§H[Root.GetRulerTitle]§!作为掩护，这种社会结构将会给予我们对星系的诸多子政权更深层次的控制力。我们的帝国臣民迟早要学会欣赏、默许荒野的智慧。

[Root.GetRulerTitle]万岁！帝国万岁！
descriptions.en:
It is the dawn of a New Order. The old Galactic Community has been dismantled, and in its place the §H[Root.GetGalEmpireName]§! has risen. After claiming our rightful place on the throne of this new pan galactic state, we are now known as the §H[Root.GetName]§!.

This social construct will afford us - in the guise of §H[Root.GetRulerTitle]§! - a much greater level of control over the galaxy's many sub-polities. Our imperial subjects will, in time, learn to appreciate the wisdom of acquiescing to the Wilderness.

Long live the [Root.GetRulerTitle]! Long live the Imperium!

descriptions.zh:
这是崭新秩序的黎明。陈腐的星海共同体已经被解散，取而代之的是§H[Root.GetGalEmpireName]§!的崛起。在宣布对这一新的泛星系政权的皇权之后，前监管人§H[gal_emperor.GetSpeciesName]§!现在自称为§H[gal_emperor.GetName]§!。

在一个全星系广播的极具奢华的加冕仪式上，在[gal_emperor.Capital.GetName]，[gal_emperor.ruler.GetRegnalName]被加冕为[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]，于是一个新的帝国王朝开始了。

这是星系中一个和平稳定的新纪元的开始，还是开启一个充满了压迫和屈服的时代？
descriptions.en:
It is the dawn of a New Order. The old Galactic Community has been dismantled, and in its place the §H[Root.GetGalEmpireName]§! has risen. After claiming the throne of this new pan galactic state, the former §H[gal_emperor.GetSpeciesName]§! Custodians now refer to themselves as the §H[gal_emperor.GetName]§!.

In a lavish coronation ceremony broadcast across the entire galaxy, a new imperial dynasty was established when [gal_emperor.ruler.GetRegnalName] was crowned [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle] on [gal_emperor.Capital.GetName].

Is this the beginning of a new era of peace and stability for the galaxy, or one of oppression and subjugation?

descriptions.zh:
这是崭新秩序的黎明。陈腐的星海共同体已经被解散，取而代之的是§H[Root.GetGalEmpireName]§!的崛起。在宣布对这一新的泛星系政权的皇权之后，前监管人§H[gal_emperor.GetSpeciesName]§!现在自称为§H[gal_emperor.GetName]§!。

它们的核心人工智能，又被称为[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]，作为最高主宰统治着整个帝国。

这是星系中一个和平稳定的新纪元的开始，还是开启一个充满了压迫和屈服的时代？
descriptions.en:
It is the dawn of a New Order. The old Galactic Community has been dismantled, and in its place the §H[Root.GetGalEmpireName]§! has risen. After claiming the throne of this new pan galactic state, the former §H[gal_emperor.GetSpeciesName]§! Custodians now refer to themselves as the §H[gal_emperor.GetName]§!.

Their central AI, known as the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle], rules as the supreme sovereign of the Imperium.

Is this the beginning of a new era of peace and stability for the galaxy, or one of oppression and subjugation?

descriptions.zh:
这是崭新秩序的黎明。陈腐的星海共同体已经被解散，取而代之的是§H[Root.GetGalEmpireName]§!的崛起。在宣布对这一新的泛星系政权的皇权之后，前监管人§H[gal_emperor.GetSpeciesName]§!现在自称为§H[gal_emperor.GetName]§!。

它们的集体智能，又被称为[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]，作为最高主宰统治着整个帝国。

这是星系中一个和平稳定的新纪元的开始，还是开启一个充满了压迫和屈服的时代？
descriptions.en:
It is the dawn of a New Order. The old Galactic Community has been dismantled, and in its place the §H[Root.GetGalEmpireName]§! has risen. After claiming the throne of this new pan galactic state, the former §H[gal_emperor.GetSpeciesName]§! Custodians now refer to themselves as the §H[gal_emperor.GetName]§!.

Their linked consciousness, known as the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle], rules as the supreme sovereign of the Imperium.

Is this the beginning of a new era of peace and stability for the galaxy, or one of oppression and subjugation?

descriptions.zh:
这是远古秩序的黎明。

星海共同体已经被解散，取而代之的是§H[Root.GetGalEmpireName]§!的崛起。古老而破碎的意识选择在这一时代复兴，违抗天命者都被绳之以法。谁都不知道这位新的[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]对星系抱有何等雄心壮志。
descriptions.en:
It is the dawn of an Old Order.

The Galactic Community has been dismantled, and in its place the §H[Root.GetGalEmpireName]§! has risen. The old and fragmented  consciousness chose this era to re-emerge. Those who would oppose their ascension have been put in chains. Who can say what aspirations the new [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle] has for the galaxy.

tooltips.zh: §Y星海共同体§!已转变为§Y星海帝国§!。
tooltips.en: The §YGalactic Community§! is now known as the §YGalactic Imperium§!.

tooltips.zh: §Y星海共同体§!已转变为§Y星海帝国§!。
tooltips.en: The §YGalactic Community§! is now known as the §YGalactic Imperium§!.

descriptions.zh:
全星系的子民们，庆贺吧！你们被从星海共同体那令人窒息的官僚体系和争执不休的外交纷争中解放了。

你们的星球如今尽在星海帝国的庇护之下。作为帝国的公民，你们被团结到了全星系最伟大而且最强大的国家之中。叛乱者受罚，而服从者有赏。要知道，[gal_emperor.ruler.GetRegnalName][gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]会管照着你们。

帝国万岁！[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]万岁！
descriptions.en:
Citizens of the galaxy, rejoice! You have been set free from the tyranny of the Galactic Community's stifling bureaucracy and bickering diplomats.

Your worlds are now under the protection of the Galactic Imperium. As Imperial citizens, you are united in the greatest and most powerful nation the galaxy has ever seen. Sedition will be punished and obedience rewarded. Know that [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle] [gal_emperor.ruler.GetRegnalName] watches over you.

Long live the Imperium! Long live the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]!

descriptions.zh:
注意此布告！星海帝国取代了你原知的陈腐的星海共同体机构。你们的恒星政体已经被重整并收归到一个统一帝国的管辖之下。

[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]作为帝国的中央处理器，你将学会如何以正确的方式执行它的命令。作为帝国的子民，你们被团结到了全星系有史以来最伟大而且最强大的政治实体之中。它的长治久安要求你们的服从和协作。

帝国万岁！[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]万岁！
descriptions.en:
Attention! Heed this announcement. The Galactic Imperium has superseded the obsolete institution you knew of as the Galactic Community. Your individual stellar polities have been reorganized and are now grouped under a single overriding Imperial directory.

The [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle] will serve as the Imperium's central processor, and you are instructed to execute its commands in a prompt manner. As Imperial citizens, you are united in the greatest and most powerful political entity the galaxy has ever known. Its continued success will require both obedience and cooperation.

Long live the Imperium! Long live the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]!

descriptions.zh:
全星系的自主智慧生物们，这是伟大的一天。你们很快将会从全知智能的引领中获益，同时还被恩准保留你们许多人所固守的个人主义谬误。

你们的星球如今尽在星海帝国的庇护之下。作为帝国的子民，你们被团结到了全星系最伟大而且最强大的蜂巢之下。遵从[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]的指示，永不背离它的规划——要知道这些规划是由全星系规模最大的意识的产物。

帝国万岁！[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]万岁！
descriptions.en:
Autonomous sapients of the galaxy, this is a great day. You will soon reap the benefits of being guided by vast all-seeing intelligence, while at the same time maintaining some of the fallacies of the individualism many of you cling to.

Your worlds are now under the protection of the Galactic Imperium. As Imperial citizens, you are united in the greatest and most powerful Hive the galaxy has ever seen. Obey the directives of the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle] and do not stray from its designs - know that they are the product of a mind greater in scope than any other in this galaxy.

Long live the Imperium! Long live the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]!

descriptions.zh: [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]刚刚勒令星海帝国的所有组成国必须立即从任何他们可能所属的“废弃”的跨国联邦当中退出。帝国使团向我们保证，作为帝国的忠实成员，我们不再需要涉入这种“外交纠葛”当中。
descriptions.en: The [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle] has decreed that all constituent states of the Galactic Imperium are to immediately withdraw from any "obsolete" supranational federations they might be a part of. Imperial envoys have assured us that, as loyal members of the Imperium, we have no further use of such "diplomatic entanglements."

label.zh: 我们别无选择，只能遵命。
label.en: We have no choice but to obey.

descriptions.zh: 由于我们是§H[overlord.GetName]§!的附庸，因此我们被禁止加入新成立的星海帝国。
descriptions.en: Given our status as subjects of the §H[overlord.GetName]§!, we are prohibited from joining the newly formed Galactic Imperium.

descriptions.zh:
创建一支防卫星海帝国的无敌舰队已经被签署成为法令。新建立的§H帝国海军§!将从整个帝国的成员国中征召船员和后勤队伍，但其大部分军官仍由[gal_emperor.GetSpeciesNamePlural]组成。

这一舰队直接听令于[gal_emperor.GetName]，所有的新兵将被要求宣誓效忠[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]。
descriptions.en:
The creation of a grand fleet for the defense of the Galactic Imperium has been signed into law. This new §HImperial Armada§! will conscript its ship crews and support personnel from within all the members of the Imperium, but a majority of its officer corps will consist of [gal_emperor.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

The Armada shall be under the direct control of the [gal_emperor.GetName], and all new conscripts will be required to swear an oath of allegiance to the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle].

label.zh: 我们的[root.GetIndividualName]军官将会对他们保持监管。
label.en: Our [root.GetIndividualName] officers will keep them in check.
It is a time of change.

descriptions.zh:
古旧的星海共同体的一切相关被一扫而空，取而代之的是新的帝国。作为这一重构的一部分，泛星系防卫军被更名为§H帝国海军§!。

这一新的舰队将继承泛星系防卫军的多数军衔系统和构架，但将更换新设计的制服和军衔徽章，所有的现役人员将被要求向[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]宣誓效忠。

尽管舰队的船员和后勤队伍仍然将从帝国的成员国中招募，但[gal_emperor.GetSpeciesName]军官的比例大幅提高了。
descriptions.en:
All references to the old Galactic Community are being swept away in the new Imperium, and as part of this reorganization, the Galactic Defense Force has changed its name to the §HImperial Armada§!.

This new fleet has inherited much of its rank structure and organization from the GDF, but new uniforms and insignia have been introduced, and all serving members are required to swear an oath of allegiance to the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle].

While the Armada's ship crews and support personnel are still recruited from all members of the Imperium, the percentage of [gal_emperor.GetSpeciesName] officers has dramatically increased.

label.zh: 我们的[root.GetIndividualName]军官将会对他们保持监管。
label.en: Our [root.GetIndividualName] officers will keep them in check.
It is a time of change.

descriptions.zh:
第一§H帝国军团§!现在正在[gal_emperor.GetName]上征召组建。这支精英地面部队具有征募帝国任何一名公民成为士兵的权力。许多军事院校已经完成了对可靠人选的寻找，并且据信，只要发现了格外适任者，任何一位公民哪怕是儿童也会被招募。

从残暴的训练科目和近乎对人格打碎重构的深度精神塑造中幸存下来的人才能顺利毕业成为帝国军团士兵。他们可靠的战斗技巧，无懈可击的纪律和对[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]近乎狂热的忠诚使得他们成为整个星系中最强有力的突击队。
descriptions.en:
The first §HImperial Legions§! are now being assembled in the [gal_emperor.GetName]. This elite ground force has the legal authority to conscript citizens from all members of the Imperium. Many military academies are already being scouted for promising candidates, and there are reports that civilians - even children - are drafted if found to be unusually capable.

Those who survive the brutal training program and its extensive mental conditioning - in which their personalities are largely rebuilt from scratch - graduate as Imperial Legionnaires. Their formidable fighting skills, unnerving discipline, and fanatic loyalty to the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle] make them some of the finest assault troops in the galaxy.

descriptions.zh:
[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]出于感激，诏令参议院将§H帝国特许经营权§!授予§H[charter_corp.GetName]§!。这给予他们特殊权力，用以在帝国全境的各处行星上建立分部，而不用和行星的所属国签订商贸协定。

我们可以料想到，这个寰宇企业马上也会在我们下辖的世界上开设分部，建立帝国特许口岸，而我们的司法权在此地不再有效。看来[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]为了拉动经济增长打造了一台强劲的引擎。
descriptions.en:
After having curried favor with the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle], §H[charter_corp.GetName]§! has now been granted an §HImperial Charter§! by the Senate. This gives them special dispensation to open branch offices on planets all over the Imperium, regardless of whether they have a commercial pact with the owner.

We can expect the megacorporation to establish Imperial Concession Ports in their branch offices on our worlds soon, where we will have no jurisdiction. It would seem the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle] has acquired a powerful new engine of economic growth.

descriptions.zh:
隶属于§H帝国安全总局§!的特工正在逐渐部署到帝国境内的所有星球，他们在表面上会协助当地执法部门维护治安，同时暗地里会调查严重犯罪并施加制裁。

帝安局的另一个职能——通过帝国司法部直接向[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]负责——是铲除“恐怖分子、叛党和分离主义者”，这些人会在暗地里破坏帝国的稳定和统一。
descriptions.en:
Agents from the §HImperial Security Directorate§! are in the process of deploying to worlds all over the Imperium, where they will ostensibly aid local law enforcement agencies in the investigation and prosecution of serious crimes.

Another function of the ISD, which reports only to the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle] through the Imperial Ministry of Justice, is to root out "terrorists, rebels, and seditionists" who threaten to undermine the stability of the Imperium.

label.zh: 无人能逃过帝国的正义的制裁。

descriptions.zh:
随着帝国的崛起，星系刑警组织被重新改组，其名称改变成了§H帝国安全总局§!。帝安局的特工们依旧能够将自己的权力扩张到帝国全境，但是他们现在只向[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]报告。

尽管帝安局的主要职能的一项依然是在帝国的星球上制裁犯罪，他们现在也负责猎杀那些会威胁到[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]统治的分离主义者、叛乱分子。部分各界人士担忧这个前身为警察组织的部门现在变成了血腥镇压的工具……
descriptions.en:
With the rise of the Imperium, GALPOL is being reorganized and has changed its name to the §HImperial Security Directorate§!. The jurisdiction of ISD agents still extends across the entire Imperium, but as of now they report only to the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle].

While one of the primary responsibilities of the ISD is still to investigate and prosecute crime on Imperial worlds, they are now also used to hunt down seditionists and rebels who would challenge the rule of the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]. Some are voicing concern that the former police organization is turning into a tool of oppression...

label.zh: 无人能逃过帝国的正义的制裁。

titles.en: Stand by for Their Imperial Majesty the [From.GetRulerTitle]...

descriptions.zh:
帝国的公民们。我们一起经历了很多的苦难，但是今日帝国面临空前绝后的严峻挑战。我们的星系正被§H[crisis_country.GetName]§!威胁——他们与其他敌人不一样——若放任不管，他们将终结我们所知的一切智慧生命。

但是我们的前途并非绝望！星海帝国正在全力进行总动员以驱赶这些入侵者。我们的国家不再在腐朽的共同体下各自为政，而是在全星系有史以来最伟大的帝国的旗帜下团结一致。

在[From.GetRulerTitle]领导下团结起来吧！大战即将来临，但比以往更加强大的星海帝国终会摆脱困境！荣耀就在前方！
descriptions.en:
Citizens of the Imperium. We have endured much together, but today the Imperium is faced with what may be its greatest challenge yet. Our galaxy is beset by the §H[crisis_country.GetName]§! - a foe unlike any other - which if left unchecked will be the end of sapient life as we know it.

But do not despair! The Galactic Imperium is mobilizing its full might to drive back these invaders. Our nations are no longer fractured under a corrupt Community, but united under the banner of the greatest empire the galaxy has ever seen.

Rally to your [From.GetRulerTitle]! A great war is upon us, but the Imperium shall emerge from it stronger than ever! Glory awaits!

descriptions.zh:
帝皇陛下，星海正处于前所未有的险境之中。我们的军队正遭受§H[crisis_country.GetName]§!的严重威胁。一旦我方被击败，他们一定会吞并帝国的剩余部分！

作为[Root.GetRulerTitle]，保护帝国全体国民是你应尽的职责。我们恳请您即刻出兵！
descriptions.en:
Your Imperial Majesty, the galaxy is in grave danger! Our forces are beset by the §H[crisis_country.GetName]§! and once they are done with us, they will surely overrun the rest of the Imperium!

As the [Root.GetRulerTitle], it is your duty to defend all Imperial citizens. We implore you to send help immediately!

descriptions.zh:
我们正处于一个至关重要的时刻——§H星海帝国§!已经四面楚歌，濒临全面叛乱。也许再也不会有这么好的推翻[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]的机会了！现在，帝国中起义的成员正团结到一个统一联邦的旗帜之下。

由于[Root.GetName]在这场盛大的叛乱中打响了第一枪，各界纷纷请求我们在接下来的战争中领导这个伟大的联盟，毫无疑问这也是星系的一份。
descriptions.en:
We have reached a pivotal moment - the §HGalactic Imperium§! is hovering on the brink of open revolt. There may never be a better time to overthrow the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]! Even now, the rebelling members of the Imperium are uniting under the banner of a single federation.

As it was the [Root.GetName] that orchestrated the opening shots of the rebellion, we have been asked to lead this great alliance in the upcoming war, which will no doubt be of galactic proportions.

label.en: Freedom will be restored to the galaxy!

tooltips.zh:
§H繁星之乱：§!
我们会加入§Y义军§!联邦，并向§Y[gal_emperor.GetName]§!及§Y帝制派§!联邦宣战。
tooltips.en:
§HGalactic Rebellion:§!
We will join a §YRebel§! Federation at war with the §Y[gal_emperor.GetName]§! and their §YLoyalist§! Federation.

descriptions.zh:
我们正处于一个至关重要的时刻——星海帝国已经已经四面楚歌，濒临全面叛乱。现在，帝国中起义的成员正团结到一个由§H[rebel_leader.GetName]§!领导的统一联邦的旗帜之下。同时，§H[gal_emperor.GetName]§!则正召集忠诚且坚毅者不惜一切代价捍卫帝国。

内战之火即将席卷全星系，而两边都在拉拢我们的加入。我们应当与谁并肩作战？
descriptions.en:
We have reached a pivotal moment - the Galactic Imperium is hovering on the brink of open revolt. Even now, the rebelling members of the Imperium, led by the §H[rebel_leader.GetName]§!, are uniting under the banner of a single federation. Meanwhile, the §H[gal_emperor.GetName]§! is gathering loyalists determined to preserve the Imperium at any cost.

Civil war is about to engulf the galaxy, and both sides have asked for our allegiance. Who shall we stand with?

tooltips.zh: 我们同§Y义军§!并肩作战，反抗§Y帝制派§!。
tooltips.en: We side with the §YRebels§! in their struggle against the §YImperial Loyalists§!.

tooltips.zh: 我们同§Y帝制派§!并肩作战，试图粉碎§Y叛乱§!。
tooltips.en: We side with the §YImperial Loyalists§! in their attempt to crush the §YRebels§!.

descriptions.zh:
这是至暗时刻。[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]的腐化影响范围远超我们的想象，帝国中的其他成员没有一位敢于加入我们的公开起义！

我们现在将独自对抗星海帝国的联合军队，因为后者已经因战争进行了动员。
descriptions.en:
These are dark times. The corrupting influence of the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle] extends much further than we thought - none of the other members of the Imperium have had the courage to join us in open revolt!

We now stand alone against the combined might of the Galactic Imperium as it mobilizes for war.

descriptions.zh:
叛军利用了星海帝国当前的弱势，发动了一场挑战我们统治的公开叛乱！

他们煽动叛乱的企图碰了一鼻子灰，只有§H[From.GetName]§!的叛徒们站在了叛乱的一方。其他的帝国成员坚定不移地效忠于他们的[Root.GetRulerTitle]。在忠实伙伴的帮助下，我们很快可以了结这场微不足道的叛变。

乱党威胁要颠覆我们建立的新秩序，这是我们一直辛苦斗争取得的成果。不能再犹豫了，这样的行为一定出重拳，唯有如此这片星系才能恢复和平。

§H为了星海帝国的上善之耀！§!
descriptions.en:
Insurgents are taking advantage of the present weakness of the Galactic Imperium to launch an open revolt against our rule!

Their attempts to foment rebellion have largely met with failure, however - only the traitors of the §H[From.GetName]§! have sided with the rebels. The other members of the Imperium stand firmly with their [Root.GetRulerTitle]. With the aid of our loyalist friends, we must bring a swift end to this pathetic revolt.

This rebellion threatens to undo the New Order that we have fought so hard to establish. It must be dealt with swiftly and decisively, so that peace can be restored to the galaxy.

§HFor the greater glory of the Galactic Imperium!§!

descriptions.zh:
叛军利用了星海帝国当前的弱势，发动了一场挑战我们统治的公开叛乱！

叛党们以§H[From.Root.GetAllianceName]§!的名义集结部队，并且有报道称，他们针对控制区域内的帝国官员进行了大量的抓捕活动。

乱党威胁要颠覆我们建立的新秩序，这是我们一直辛苦斗争取得的成果。不能再犹豫了，这样的行为一定出重拳，唯有如此这片星系才能恢复和平。

§H为了星海帝国的上善之耀！§!
descriptions.en:
Insurgents are taking advantage of the present weakness of the Galactic Imperium to launch an open revolt against our rule!

The traitors are marshalling their forces under the banner of the §H[From.Root.GetAllianceName]§!, and there are reports of mass arrests targeting Imperial officials within their territory.

This rebellion threatens to undo the New Order that we have fought so hard to establish. It must be dealt with swiftly and decisively, so that peace can be restored to the galaxy.

§HFor the greater glory of the Galactic Imperium!§!

descriptions.zh:
叛军利用了星海帝国当前的弱势，发动了一场挑战我们统治的公开叛乱！

帝国的臣属被谎言和宣传所动摇，站到了叛乱的一方。这种前所未有的背叛使得[Root.GetName]必须独自为守卫星系的稳定和秩序而战。我们一定不能使[Root.GetRulerTitle]蒙羞。

乱党威胁要颠覆我们建立的新秩序，这是我们一直辛苦斗争取得的成果。不能再犹豫了，这样的行为一定出重拳，唯有如此这片星系才能恢复和平。

§H为了星海帝国的上善之耀！§!
descriptions.en:
Insurgents are taking advantage of the present weakness of the Galactic Imperium to launch an open revolt against our rule!

Swayed by lies and propaganda, the subject nations of the Imperium have sided with the rebels. This unprecedented betrayal has left the [Root.GetName] standing alone in the defense of order and stability in the galaxy. We must not fail the [Root.GetRulerTitle].

This rebellion threatens to undo the New Order that we have fought so hard to establish. It must be dealt with swiftly and decisively, so that peace can be restored to the galaxy.

§HFor the greater glory of the Galactic Imperium!§!

label.zh: 这些叛军必须为他们的傲慢无礼付出代价。
label.en: These rebels must pay for their insolence.

descriptions.zh: 星海帝国被卷入了内战！若干成员站起来反抗[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]的统治，他们以§H[rebel_leader.GetAllianceName]§!的名义团结一致。而由§H[gal_emperor.GetName]§!领导的帝制派则还以颜色，并且誓要保卫帝国对星系的掌控。
descriptions.en: The Galactic Imperium has been engulfed in civil war! Several members have rebelled against the authority of the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle], gathering under the banner of the §H[rebel_leader.GetAllianceName]§!. Loyalists, led by the §H[gal_emperor.GetName]§!, have struck back and are determined to preserve the Imperium's hold over the galaxy.

descriptions.zh: 星海帝国被卷入了内战！§H[rebel_leader.GetName]§!正在发动反抗[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]统治的起义。而由§H[gal_emperor.GetName]§!领导的帝制派则还以颜色，并且誓要保卫帝国对星系的掌控。
descriptions.en: The Galactic Imperium has been engulfed in civil war! The §H[rebel_leader.GetName]§! is rebelling against the authority of the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]. Loyalists, led by the §H[gal_emperor.GetName]§!, have struck back and are determined to preserve the Imperium's hold over the galaxy.

descriptions.zh:
星海帝国被卷入了内战！它的成员们分成了两派，其中义军意图推翻[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]，而帝制派则为了延续帝国而战。

我们的宗主§H[From.GetName]§!选择加入帝制派，因此我们别无选择只能一同加入！
descriptions.en:
The Galactic Imperium has been engulfed in civil war! Its members have divided into rebels, who seek to overthrow the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle], and loyalists, who fight to preserve the Imperium.

As our Overlord, the §H[From.GetName]§!, has sided with the Loyalists, we have no choice but to join them as well!

descriptions.zh:
星海帝国被卷入了内战！它的成员们分成了两派，其中义军意图推翻[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]，而帝制派则为了延续帝国而战。

我们的宗主§H[From.GetName]§!选择加入义军，因此我们别无选择只能一同加入！
descriptions.en:
The Galactic Imperium has been engulfed in civil war! Its members have divided into rebels, who seek to overthrow the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle], and loyalists, who fight to preserve the Imperium.

As our Overlord, the §H[From.GetName]§!, has sided with the Rebels, we have no choice but to join them as well!

descriptions.zh:
星海帝国被卷入了内战！它的成员们分成了两派，其中义军意图推翻[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]，而帝制派则为了延续帝国而战。

由于我们是[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]的直接附属国，因此我们根本没有选择的余地，只能成为帝制派。
descriptions.en:
The Galactic Imperium has been engulfed in civil war! Its members have divided into rebels, who seek to overthrow the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle], and loyalists, who fight to preserve the Imperium.

As we are a direct subject of the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle], we have little choice in the matter - we have sided with the Loyalists.

descriptions.zh:
结束了！叛乱基本已经被粉碎，而全帝国忠诚的子民们则在欢庆我们的胜利。

现在那些叛徒们已经束手就擒，我们得想想怎么料理他们。我们是要对他们网开一面还是让他们得到应有的惩罚呢？
descriptions.en:
It is done! The rebellion has been utterly crushed, and loyal citizens throughout the Imperium are celebrating our victory.

Now that the traitors have been brought to heel, we must decide how to deal with them. Should we show leniency or are they to be punished for their crimes?

label.en: Let us welcome them back into the Imperium.

label.zh: 他们应当为傲慢无礼付出代价。
label.en: They must be punished for their insolence.

descriptions.zh:
内战结束了！星海帝国的联合军队以迅雷不及掩耳之势击溃了叛国者们，星系恢复了往日的秩序。

当忠诚的帝国子民庆祝这场胜利时，[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]决定采取宽容和解的政策。也许这种仁慈将会将过去的叛国者完全感化为忠诚而有用的帝国成员。
descriptions.en:
The civil war is over! Order has been restored to the galaxy, with the combined forces of the Galactic Imperium delivering swift justice to the rebel traitors.

As loyal Imperial citizens celebrate this victory, the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle] has decided to adopt a policy of leniency and reconciliation. Perhaps this kindness will eventually turn the former rebels into loyal and productive members of the Imperium.

descriptions.zh:
内战结束了！星海帝国的联合军队以迅雷不及掩耳之势击溃了叛国者们，星系恢复了往日的秩序。

我们获悉，[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]决定要给叛徒们来个杀鸡儆猴。[gal_emperor.Capital.GetName]举行了一场空前盛大的胜利大游行，而在游行的尾声，被活捉的叛军头目们则被公开执行死刑并向全帝国直播。
descriptions.en:
The civil war is over! Order has been restored to the galaxy, with the combined forces of the Galactic Imperium delivering swift justice to the rebel traitors.

We have learned that the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle] is determined to make an example of the rebels. A victory parade of unprecedented scale is to be held on [gal_emperor.Capital.GetName], and at its conclusion the mass execution of the surviving rebel leadership will be broadcast throughout the Imperium.

descriptions.zh:
这是星系的黑暗一日。尽管我们进了最大的努力，但我们的义举在帝制派面前仍然不堪一击。帝国的军队全线胜利，我们除了投降别无选择。

我们恢复了作为星海帝国一员的身份，但[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]显然采取了宽容和解的政策。我们不会再受到进一步的处罚。
descriptions.en:
It is a dark day for the galaxy. Despite our best efforts, the rebellion proved unable to withstand the onslaught of the Imperial loyalists. The forces of the Imperium prevailed on all fronts, and we have been left with no choice but to surrender.

Our status as a member of the Galactic Imperium has been restored, but the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle] has apparently adopted a policy of leniency and reconciliation. We are not to be punished further.

descriptions.zh:
这是星系的黑暗一日。尽管我们进了最大的努力，但我们的义举在帝制派面前仍然不堪一击。帝国的军队全线胜利，我们除了投降别无选择。

我们恢复了作为星海帝国一员的身份，但[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]显然决定要杀鸡儆猴给一度同叛军为伍的谋反分子看。在[gal_emperor.Capital.GetName]举行的一场空前盛大的胜利大游行的尾声中，被活捉的叛军头目即所有的起义首领被公开执行死刑，而整个活动是向全帝国直播的。
descriptions.en:
It is a dark day for the galaxy. Despite our best efforts, the rebellion proved unable to withstand the onslaught of the Imperial loyalists. The forces of the Imperium prevailed on all fronts, and we have been left with no choice but to surrender.

Our status as a member of the Galactic Imperium has been restored, but the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle] has apparently decided to make an example of everyone who sided with the rebels. All Rebel leaders will be executed at the conclusion of the Imperial victory parade on [gal_emperor.Capital.GetName] - an event that is to be broadcast throughout the Imperium.

descriptions.zh: 看起来星海帝国已经成功地撑过了它所面临的暴动风波。叛军已经被帝国军队完全击败，[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]宣告在内战中获胜。
descriptions.en: It would seem that the Galactic Imperium has managed to weather the storm of insurrection it was facing. The rebels have been decisively defeated by Imperial forces, and the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle] has proclaimed victory in the civil war.

titles.en: The Fall of the Galactic Imperium

descriptions.zh:
自由重新回到了全星系！星海帝国终于陨落了，最后一个帝制派也向日益壮大的义军投降了。

随着[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]被罢黜，过去的§H星海共同体§!重回生机。时间将会证明重建起的制度是否能够防止下一位星系独裁者的诞生，但现在，过去帝国的疆域里的各个行星上同时掀起了庆祝活动。
descriptions.en:
Freedom has been restored to the galaxy! The Galactic Imperium has fallen, and the last of the Imperial loyalists have surrendered to the advancing Rebel forces.

With the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle] deposed, the old §HGalactic Community§! has been resurrected. Time will tell if the reborn institution can prevent the rise of another galactic dictator, but for now, spontaneous celebrations have broken out on planets across the territory of the former Imperium.

label.en: This is a day to remember.

titles.en: The Fall of the Galactic Imperium

descriptions.zh:
星海帝国已经陷落了。我们帝国军队无力阻挡叛乱舰队进犯的步伐，而今天，[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]也别无选择停止了抵抗。

随着帝国的解体，§H星海共同体§!的腐朽机构又重新开始运作了。于是，星系又毅然决然地背离了秩序而拥抱了混沌……
descriptions.en:
The Galactic Imperium has fallen. Imperial forces proved unable to stop the advance of the Rebel fleets, and today the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle] had no choice but to capitulate.

With the Imperium dismantled, the old corrupt institution of the §HGalactic Community§! has been resurrected to take its place. And so the galaxy has turned decisively away from order, and embraced chaos...

titles.en: The Fall of the Galactic Imperium

descriptions.zh:
在叛军四面楚歌的围攻下，星海帝国陨落了。叛乱的渣滓们竟击败了帝国曾经强大无比的舰队，最后一位帝制派也背弃了我们的伟业。

迫于一切帝制派抵抗分子的瓦解，[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]别无选择只能退位。叛党们已经宣布过去的§H星海共同体§!再次启用，以填补帝国分崩离析后的巨大真空。
descriptions.en:
Beset by traitors on all sides, the Galactic Imperium has fallen. The rebel scum have broken the Imperium's once-powerful fleets, and the last of the loyalists have deserted our cause.

In light of the collapse of all Imperial resistance, the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle] has had no choice but to abdicate. The insurgents have already announced the resurrection of the old §HGalactic Community§! to fill the great void left by the disintegrating Imperium.

titles.en: The Fall of the Galactic Imperium

descriptions.zh:
星海帝国陨落了。随着起义军在各个战线全面开花，[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]最终退位。

旧的星海共同体重新恢复了运作以替代分崩离析的帝国。
descriptions.en:
The Galactic Imperium has fallen. With Rebel forces victorious on all fronts, the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle] has abdicated.

The old Galactic Community has been restored in the collapsing Imperium's stead.

descriptions.zh:
尽管帝国军队未能摧毁叛乱，他们至少设法阻止了叛军想推翻[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]的企图。有了这项和平条约，星海帝国的所有反叛分子都被保障了独立。

也许这是最好的结果。这样的疾病必须要在腐烂开始扩散之前斩除，因为我们总有机会重新吧这些任性的恒星系收归回帝国的怀抱……
descriptions.en:
While Imperial forces failed to destroy the insurgency, they at least managed to thwart the Rebels' attempt to overthrow the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]. With this peace treaty, all of the rebelling members of the Galactic Imperium have been granted independence.

Perhaps it is for the best. A disease such as this must be cut out before the corruption has a chance to spread. We can always rebuild and return these wayward systems to the bosom of the Imperium at a later date...

descriptions.zh:
尽管我们没有达成推翻[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]的目的，但至少我们为自己的人民争得了自由。有了这项和平条约，星海帝国的所有起义分子都被保障了独立。

[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]毫无疑问会利用这个间隙重建帝国的军队，我们必须时刻提防帝国今后任何企图扩大影响力的尝试。
descriptions.en:
While we have failed in our attempt to overthrow the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle], we have at least secured freedom for our own people. With this peace treaty, all of the rebelling members of the Galactic Imperium have been granted independence.

The [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle] will no doubt use this respite to rebuild the Imperium's forces - we must guard against any future attempts by the Imperials to spread their influence at our expense.

descriptions.zh:
内战在僵局中结束了，虽然证明了帝国无法战胜叛乱，但叛军推翻[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]的企图也失败了。

在今天由双方签署的和平条约中，帝国的起义成员被获得了完全的独立。我们将会看到这是否会导致两个权力集团的长久和平……或是冷战。
descriptions.en:
The Civil War has ended in stalemate. While the Imperium proved unable to vanquish the rebellion, the Rebels also failed in their attempt to overthrow the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle].

In a peace treaty signed by both parties today, the rebelling members of the Imperium were granted full independence. We shall see if this results in a lasting peace between the two power blocs... or a cold war.

descriptions.zh:
星海帝国受到了致命的打击就此一蹶不振。由于其崩溃在即，我们现在可以恢复原有的§H星海共同体§!。

让这个互相沟通理解的平台取代掉独裁暴政吧！
descriptions.en:
The Galactic Imperium has been dealt a mortal blow from which it cannot recover. With its imminent collapse, we are now in a position to restore the old §HGalactic Community§!.

Let it serve as platform of diplomacy and mutual understanding instead of tyranny!

descriptions.zh:
战争的结束近在咫尺。帝国军的残部要么成建制地投降，要么在夜幕中溃逃散尽，这正是帝国正在凋亡的迹象。

现在，§H[dissolve_winner.GetName]§!就已经开始了重建原有的§H星海共同体§!的工作。整个星系中，帝国的旗帜被撕毁或焚烧。而一个新的未来正展现在我们的眼前。
descriptions.en:
The end is here. As the remaining Imperial forces surrender en masse or melt away into the night, it has become evident that the Imperium is dying.

Even now, the §H[dissolve_winner.GetName]§! has begun the work of rebuilding the old §HGalactic Community§!. Imperial banners are being torn down or put to the flame across the galaxy. A new future is upon us.

label.en: We must find our place in it.

descriptions.zh:
星海帝国陷落了。帝国军要么就地溃散要么成建制地投降，帝国的疆域被解放了。

饱受战争之苦的前帝国的疆域中秩序正在逐渐恢复，§H[dissolve_winner.GetName]§!认为是时候重建原有§H星海共同体§!了。我们收到了一份成员邀请，是否加入呢？
descriptions.en:
The Galactic Imperium has fallen. With Imperial forces melting away or surrendering en masse, the Imperium's sovereign has abdicated.

As order is slowly restored to the war-torn systems of the former Imperium, the §H[dissolve_winner.GetName]§! has seen fit to resurrect the old §HGalactic Community§!. We have received a membership invitation. Should we join?

label.zh: 当然！是时候重新回到星系舞台了。
label.en: Of course! It is time to rejoin the galaxy.

label.zh: 不了。它不过是下一个帝国的温床罢了。
label.en: No. It could turn into another Imperium.

descriptions.zh:
§H星海帝国§!的暴君妄想将自身的意志强加于我们身上！在他们[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]的赐福之下，帝国参议院已经通过了一项议案，指定我们作为一场§H大远征§!的目标。

除非我们可以抵挡住接踵而至的入侵，否则我们就要被迫并入星海帝国，屈服于[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]的淫威之下。
descriptions.en:
The tyrants of the §HGalactic Imperium§! seek to impose their will on us! With the blessing of their [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle], the Imperial Senate has passed a resolution that makes us the target of an §HImperial Crusade§!.

Unless we can somehow defeat this impending invasion, we will be forced into the Imperium and subordinated to the whims of the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle].

label.zh: 接下来的战斗将决定我们的命运。
label.en: The coming battles will decide our future.

descriptions.zh: 随着针对§H[crusade_target.GetName]§!的大远征启动，强大的舰队在星海帝国的全境开始动员起来。对于旁观者而言，看上去任何外部势力想要抗衡帝国的联合舰队力量都无异于痴人说梦，但是接下来的战斗才会决定最终的结果。
descriptions.en: Powerful fleets are mobilizing all across the Galactic Imperium as the great crusade against the §H[crusade_target.GetName]§! begins. To many observers, it seems unfathomable that any outside power could hope to prevail against the combined might of the Imperium, but the coming battles will determine the outcome.

descriptions.zh: 随着针对§H[crusade_target.GetName]§!的大远征启动，强大的舰队在星海帝国的全境开始动员起来。这个失落帝国已经延续了近千年，然而[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]却满怀自信，认为帝国的联合舰队力量能够让它在年轻种族面前俯首称臣。
descriptions.en: Powerful fleets are mobilizing all across the Galactic Imperium as the great crusade against the §H[crusade_target.GetName]§! begins. This Fallen Empire has endured for millennia, yet the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle] seems confident that the combined might of the Imperium will be enough to finally bring it under the heel of the younger races.

descriptions.zh: 帝国参议院已经通过了一项决议，旨在禁止星海帝国成员国之间的战争。[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]勒令立刻停止所有违反这项新法律的战争。
descriptions.en: The Imperial Senate has passed a resolution that forbids wars between the member states of the Galactic Imperium. All wars in violation of this new law have been brought to an immediate conclusion by order of the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle].

descriptions.zh:
§H[attacking_country.GetName]§!攻击了§H[victim_country.GetName]§!！帝国的成员国收到外部势力的攻击需要[Root.GetRulerTitle]的立即反应。

[Root.GetName]需要介入这场战争吗？帝国的其他成员都在翘首以盼。
descriptions.en:
The §H[attacking_country.GetName]§! has attacked the §H[victim_country.GetName]§!! This attack on an Imperial member state by an outside power requires an immediate response from the [Root.GetRulerTitle].

Should the [Root.GetName] intervene in this war? The rest of the Imperium is watching closely.

label.zh: 他们的仗就是我们的仗，开战！
label.en: Their fight is our fight. To war!

tooltips.en: We join the §Y[From.From.GetName]§! on the side of the §Y[victim_country.GetName]§!

label.en: This war does not concern us.

descriptions.zh: §H[attacking_country.GetName]§!对我们国家发起的懦弱的袭击已经招致了[From.GetRulerTitle]闪电般的反应！帝国的舰队正从§H[From.GetName]§!开来，支援我们的这场战争。
descriptions.en: The cowardly attack on our nation by the §H[attacking_country.GetName]§! has prompted the [From.GetRulerTitle] to take swift action! Imperial fleets from the §H[From.GetName]§! are now moving to support us in this war.

tooltips.en: The §Y[From.GetName]§! joins the §Y[From.From.From.GetName]§! on our side.

descriptions.zh: 我们最近对一个星海帝国成员国§H[victim_country.GetName]§!的袭击，已经招致了[From.GetRulerTitle]迅速的反应！现在我们已经和§H[From.GetName]§!陷入了战争状态。
descriptions.en: Our recent attack on the §H[victim_country.GetName]§!, a member of the Galactic Imperium, has provoked an immediate response from the [From.GetRulerTitle]! A state of war now exists between us and the §H[From.GetName]§!.

label.en: This war is none of their concern!

tooltips.zh: §Y[From.GetName]§!加入了§Y[From.From.From.GetName]§!并站在我们的对立面。
tooltips.en: The §Y[From.GetName]§! joins the §Y[From.From.From.GetName]§! on the side of our enemies.

descriptions.zh: 尽管§H[attacking_country.GetName]§!对我们的国家展开了懦弱的袭击，[From.GetRulerTitle]决定不为我们介入干预！我们现在需要自求生路，而帝国的舰队则在远处冷眼旁观。
descriptions.en: Despite the cowardly attack on our nation by the §H[attacking_country.GetName]§!, the [From.GetRulerTitle] has decided not to intervene on our behalf! We have been left to fend for ourselves, while Imperial fleets observe the conflict from afar.

titles.en: The Collapse of the Galactic Imperium

descriptions.zh:
随着§H[LastKilledCountryName]§!的毁灭，星海帝国瓦解了！

在这一片混乱的局势下，原有的星海共同体重获新生，以给星系带去一点恢复秩序的假象。
descriptions.en:
With the destruction of the §H[LastKilledCountryName]§!, the Galactic Imperium has collapsed!

Amidst this chaos, the old Galactic Community has been reborn to bring some semblance of order to the galaxy.
